You may bring on any food and beverages you like (alcohol is allowed). There is a bathroom aboard. Max capacity is 6 passengers. services.name: Cabbage Key
services.desc: Cruise to Famous Cabbage Key! Departs 9 am, Returns 4 - 4:30 pm Check-in 30 minutes before departure Begin your trip with a 2 - 2.5 hour narrated cruise on the Charlotte Harbor aquatic preserve. We will cruise from the mouth of the Peace River, down the length of the harbor, onto the Intracoastal Waterway, and among the islands of Pine Island Sound. Charlotte Harbor is home to many, many playful dolphins who love to swim with the boat on all our cruises. You will likely see them on this cruise. services.desc: Cruise to Cayo Costa! Schedule Departs 9 - 10 am, Returns 4 - 5 pm Departure and return time varies. Click on the date to determine the schedule for that day. Check-in 30 minutes prior to departure Cruise departs from Fishermen's Village in Punta Gorda, FL About The Cruise Begin your trip with a two hour narrated cruise and then you can hit the beach! Cayo Costa (Spanish for ‘small coastal island’) is an island gem that takes you back to the real Florida of 100 years ago. Cayo Costa State Park lies on an eight-mile long barrier island with a pristine, white-sand Gulf beach allowing for swimming or snorkeling in the surf, picnicking in the shade, or enjoying the sun. services.desc: Enjoy a Visit to Historic Boca Grande! Departs 9:30 am, Returns 5 pm Check-in 30 minutes prior to departure Begin your day with a delightful two-hour cruise across Charlotte Harbor. The crew will talk about local history and help spot birds, dolphins, and other marine wildlife on one of the country’s richest estuaries. Before you arrive at the island, the crew will share tips about ways to enjoy your visit to the historic seaside community of Boca Grande, located on Gasparilla Island. Our destination is Boca Grande Marina, where you’ll go ashore to enjoy 3 hours of island time. services.name: Peace River Nature Cruise
services.desc: Peace River Nature Cruise A true half-day eco tour! We depart from our dock near the mouth of the Peace River and travel upriver towards the center of the state. Experience the flora and fauna of four different ecosystems as we journey from the open waters of Charlotte Harbor into the scenic, winding Peace River. The banks are lined with overhanging trees, native grasses, and other vegetation, and basking alligators often pose to please photographers. From approximately January through April, nesting birds on rookery islands are an extra special attraction as they put on a show raising their youngsters from comical balls of fuzz to near-adult fledglings. services.name: Harbor Tour
services.desc: Harbor Tour A great introduction to Charlotte Harbor! This tour is a great introduction to beautiful Charlotte Harbor where you’ll ride on some of the same waters that were explored by Ponce De Leon over 500 years ago! During this narrated tour you’ll cruise the developed waterfront of Punta Gorda and Port Charlotte near the mouth of the Peace River and you’ll spend time in the open waters of the harbor looking for dolphins, seabirds, and other wildlife which live in this rich and productive estuary. services.desc: These trips are very popular and they do fill up, so advance reservations are needed. Some of the departures sell out weeks or even months in advance! We never overbook and there is always seating for everyone. None of our boats are “accessible” by ADA guidelines, and they are not required to be due to their small size. We cannot roll a wheelchair onto the boats but we regularly accommodate people who can get out of their wheelchair and be helped aboard. We have set up our boarding facilities and procedures to safely accommodate as many people as possible. services.desc: Sunset Cruise / Christmas Light Canal Cruise Combo Aboard the Helen M Sunset Cruise followed by a cruise through the residential canals to view Christmas lights & displays! Christmas Canal Cruises have been a tradition in Punta Gorda for 50 years! Enjoy a 2 hour cruise with approximately 1 hour spent on Charlotte Harbor enjoying a glorious sunset followed by a 1 hour canal cruise through the residential canals in Punta Gorda to view Christmas lights, displays and decorations on homes, boats, seawalls and docks. blurb: Guests join sightseeing cruises on large, comfortable boats custom designed for cruising Charlotte Harbor and the Peace River. Cruises include trips to Cabbage Key, Cayo Costa, Boca Grande, harbor tours, sunset cruises, private events, and Christmas light canal cruises. The business is family-run and has operated for over 40 years at Fishermen's Village Marina in Punta Gorda, Florida.
